  • Reference

    Make your custom regional species checklist compatible with Build_regional_checklist()

    Local_csv_download.Rd

    Downloads the CSV files given to it, and if those files have "Genus" and "Species" columns named exactly that, it will return a list of the species given to it that is compatible with Build_regional_checklist().

    Local_csv_download(loc_csvs, loc_outputname = "Local_Species")

    Arguments

    loc_csvs

    character vector. List of names of CSV files in the dataset folder with lists of species known to occur in the region or species of interest in the study. Each CSV must have columns "Genus" and "Species" named exactly that, with capitalization.

    loc_outputname

    string. Whatever you want the output file to be named (not including filetype extension .csv)

    Value

    Prints the filepath to the output CSV. Saves a CSV file of local species that is compatible with Build_regional_checklist.

    Details

    Input CSV files must be located in a folder called "datasets" in the working directory and must have "Genus" and "Species" columns named exactly that.

    Examples

    Local_csv_download(loc_csvs = c("local_sp_test.csv", "local_invert_test.csv"), 
loc_outputname = "Local_Species_FunctionTest" # choose this name based on what you want 
# your output to be. We recommend choosing something shorter than this, because you'll 
# have to input it into Build_regional_checklist(). If you leave it blank, it will give 
# the default name "Local_Species.csv" and Build_regional_checklist() will also 
# default to this and the pipeline will work. This is not recommended if you are running 
# this function multiple times for any reason.
)
